source_anchors.symbol: "Start editing notes with the text cursor at the end of the document: "

reference_recording.result: Successful actual offscreen Qt v688 recording through serialized with-oracle on a fresh basic fixture; clean shutdown and PNG inspected. Real NotesPanel checks stage until UpdateOptions, serialize/reopen and discard an abandoned draft. Actual Manage Notes menu is materialized from its own cog template; real QAction checks invert actual CheckboxManagerOptions. Unicode cursors survive tab switches and a live initial-cursor flip; real Paste creates a future editor, then real key input inserts at the new start. Six real copy-button variants cover all/current JSON/human text, natural name ordering and empty-current behavior. Actual NotePanel name middle mouse events publish text-only/title-and-text. Both real modal DialogEdit Cancel buttons close owners through recorded dirty-note confirmations while retaining all four changed global preferences, then a new dialog/serialization confirms the final choices. Clipboard input/publication and notifications are supplied/observed; no note handlers or registered content are replaced or committed.

limits: Broader Manage Notes, viewer-note interaction and Notes Options parents remain Partial; no parent completion or aliases counted. Viewer note left-click edit and right-click hide, keyboard Apply shortcut and add-on-empty-tab double-click remain unimplemented.

The note editor uses an owned native multiline TextInput and inline naming/cancel questions. Its cursor/anchor use UTF-8 bytes while Qt uses UTF-16 positions; regression translates offsets and compares actual Unicode keyboard insertion. Cog entries/separator are source-declared real Slint MenuItems; no unsupported materialized OS-menu introspection claimed.

Native Options writes only changed fields and retains unedited concurrent preferences, while cog changes use an atomic read/edit/write of the latest typed setting. Retired owner and unanswered child guards, frozen file target, reopen/import and no file-note changes on Cancel are authored native boundaries. No reference parity is claimed for programmatic concurrent dialogs beyond the recorded reachable workflows.

Rust model/store/native regressions are authored for hosted CI, not run locally. Formatter, git diff --check, Python py_compile and cached warning-aware Slint source compiler passed; no local Cargo builds/tests, mutation tests, pushes or remote/IPFS work.
